Commentary.Commentary: A great period of play after Lunch for the tourists. They took 5 wickets for just 32 runs and at one stage it looked like they will be chasing over 350, now they require 304. Debutant Lasith Embuldeniya was the pick of the bowlers and got a five-wicket haul, he was helped by Vishwa Fernando who scalped 4. South Africa will be disappointed with the end and especially with their choke. They would feel they should have had scored at least 50 more runs. Faf Du Plessis' 90 helped the lead cross the 300 run mark. It is still a very tough total to chase down here in Durban. Sri Lanka will have to bat really well get to this target, whereas South Africa will be looking for early wickets. Be right back for the final innings of this game.

OUT! It absolutely does not matter! The leg stump goes for a toss! A fuller length ball on middle and leg, Steyn goes across and looks to flick but misses the ball. The leg stump is disturbed and SOUTH AFRICA are all out for 259. SRI LANKA WILL NEED 304 to win.
1 over before the new ball is available. Does it matter though?
Flighted delivery pitching outside leg, Duanne lets it hit on the front pad.
Short and wide outside off, Olivier cuts it wide of the sweeper cover and takes a couple.
On middle and leg, Olivier flicks it away to the fielder at mid-wicket.
On middle and leg, Steyn tucks it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter on middle, Steyn tucks it away to the fielder at mid off.
Tossed up on middle, Dale looks to defend it off his front foot but does so with the outer half of the bat.
Defended safely by Olivier as he plays this one off the back foot.
A bouncer but is bowled way outside off and Duanne does not have to do anything with the ball.
Outside off on a length, the ball goes off the outside edge and runs towards point.
Well outside off, left alone by the batsman.
Duanne Olivier is the last man in.

OUT! Cleaned up! A length ball from around the wicket, landing outside off and coming in. Maharaj goes for the expansive drive and misses the line of the ball completely. It goes onto hit the top of middle stump. Nine down now the hosts! And the last 4 wickets for just 5 runs. The lead is 300 now and Sri Lanka will look to remove the last man without much more being added.
Almost snuck through! A fuller length ball on middle and Maharaj gets his bat down in the nick of time to keep the ball out towards mid-wicket.
Flighted on middle, Dale confidently blocks it.
Tossed up on middle and off, Steyn watchfully defends it.
Dale Steyn is the new man in.

OUT! Embuldeniya gets his fifth wicket. Tossed up delivery on middle and leg, Rabada looks to defend it off his front foot but gets an inside edge onto the pads. The ball lobs up near short leg, Niroshan calls for it and takes an easy catch. Lasith Embuldeniya gets a 5-wicket haul in his debut match. Take a bow, young man
Flighted on middle and leg, Rabada looks to defend it but misses. The ball lobs up to the fielder at short leg who tries to take the catch but misses.
Short and outside off, this time Maharaj is able to cut it away for a single. The lead now is 300 for South Africa.
Short and just outside off, Maharaj looks to cut it but it is too close to the off stump and he misses the cut.

Drinks has been taken here at the fall of the wicket! The last ball of the hour has brought a wicket for the Lankans, the second in this session so far. They will look to keep the lead to as less as possible. Meanwhile, Kagiso Rabada is next to the crease.

OUT! A brainfade moment! Fernando has got a wicket after bowling on a good consistent line continuously. A length ball from around the wicket and coming into du Plessis, Faf looks to leave the ball but it comes and raps him in front of the stumps. It was not even high and hence would have gone on to hit the middle or leg stump most probably. The umpire's finger goes up in an instant and the South African skipper misses out on a well-deserved hundred! An important wicket for the visitors, they will now look to wrap up the remaining batsmen quickly.

Loud appeal! Turned down by the umpire, seems too high to the naked eye. A length ball coming into the right-hander. Du Plessis looks to stand tall and flick it away onto the leg side but extra bounce causes him to miss the ball. Hits him on the thigh pad. Loud appeal from all the fielders but no movement from the umpire.
Defended back towards the bowler off the back foot.
Same line to Faf as well, he works it towards the square leg umpire.
Around the wicket and on a length outside off, defended back towards the left of the bowler. A quick single is taken.

A length ball outside off, really well punched away in front of cover. A good effort from the fielder in the deep to push that inside the rope. Saves 2 runs for his team. Everyone applauds the commitment.
Flighted on middle and leg, Faf looks to defend but gets an inside edge and onto the pads.
Pitching outside leg, du Plessis offers no shot to it and lets it hit him on his pad.
Shorter on middle and off, Faf blocks it off his back foot.
Tossed up on off, the ball spins away after pitching. Faf plays it with soft hands and gets a thick outside edge. The ball though keeps low and goes to the slip fielder.
Once again pitches it on length, du Plessis defends it off his back foot.
Shorter on middle, Faf hits it to the fielder at cover.
Sprayed down the leg side, left alone by the batsman as it is too far away to make a connection.
Yorker! Really good one too. Maharaj just about manages to remove his foot out of the way and bring his bat down to jam the ball away.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.
Full and outside off, driven towards the mid off region.
Good length ball on middle and holds its line. Defended back to the bowler by Keshav.
Hurled on a length and at the hips, worked away to deep square leg for a single. Faf moves into the 90s.
Another loopy one on middle, defended on the front foot towards mid on. End of a successful over for the visitors.
Flighted on middle, pushed back towards cover.
Keshav Maharaj walks in at number 8.

OUT! Embuldeniya has his fourth! The stumps have been disturbed as this one has kept really low. A flatter ball on middle, Vernon goes on his back foot to play this one but the ball keeps really low and goes through. Disturbs the middle stump. The good stand of 60 has been broken finally. The lead is 295 and Philander departs after doing what was expected from him.
Around the wicket to Vernon, nicely flighted and Philander comes ahead to defend. The ball goes off the outside edge towards point. A single is turned down by the non-striker.
On the pads from over the wicket to the SA skipper, he works it away towards square leg for a run.
Short and slow outside off, cut away through cover for a single. 250 comes up for the hosts! The lead is now 294.
Fuller one on leg, flicked away slightly uppishly by Vernon to long leg for a run.

Loud appeal but the umpire is unmoved yet again! Sprayed down the leg side and Philander looks to flick it away but misses the ball. It seems to have gone off the side of the trousers of the batsman to the keeper. Good decision by the umpire.
Pitching outside leg, Faf runs it down fine towards deep fine leg for a single.
Outside off and shaping away, left alone by the batsman.
Flicked away through deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Ooh! Some spice on that one. Rears up weirdly after pitching on a length, Faf du Plessis removes his hand after defending it on the back foot. Looks likes he got a jolt there.
Vishwa Fernando is back on.
Flighted outside leg, Philander lets it hit him on his front pad.
Shorter in length, du Plessis punches it towards cover and takes a single.
Tossed up outside leg, Faf stretches out his front foot and lets it hit on the pads.
Shorter in length on middle, Faf defends it off his back foot.
Shorter around off, Vernon defends it with soft hands towards point and takes a single.
Flighted on off and middle, Philander defends it.
Another leave to complete a good over from Lakmal.
FDP shoulders arms to this one outside off on a length.
Beaten! A short length ball outside off, Faf stands tall and looks to cut that one away but misses out. It was very close to being an edge!
Left alone outside off.

NOT OUT! Sri Lanka lose the review! Nothing on the ball and du Plessis survives. A length ball outside off and moving away, keeps slightly low as well. Faf looks to push it into the off side but misses the ball. The keeper dives ahead and completes a good take. He then stands up and appeals, then the slip and the bowler join in. Dickwella reckons there's an edge and asks his skipper to take it upstairs. Replays show us there was absolutely nothing on that and the ball was quite far away from the willow. Review lost by the away team as well.
Review time... For a caught behind. The Sri Lankans have taken it upstairs after it was initially given not out. There doesn't seem to be any confidence though.
Outside off on a good length, left alone by the Proteas skipper.
On the pads again, Philander lets it hit him on his pad.
Loppy ball outside leg, Vernon offers no shot to it and it hits him on his front pad.
Flighted on off, du Plessis pushes it towards mid off and takes a single.
On middle and leg, du Plessis tucks it away to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Turn and bounce on this one. Pitching outside leg and spinning away from the batsman, Faf offers no shot to this one and lets it hit him on body.
Loopy delivery on leg stump, du Plessis keeps it out with a front foot defense.

Edged! Another edge induced by Lakmal, this time off the bat of Faf. The ball again does not carry to slip. The fielder fails to stop the ball cleanly, allowing for 3 runs to be taken till it is retrieved. That also brings up the 50-run stand between these two.
A length ball outside off, defended back towards the off side.

Short of a length and the ball goes through really slowly after pitching. Du Plessis looks to pull but was too early into the shot. The keeper fails to collect it cleanly and the ball goes through his leg, almost hits the helmet kept behind. Just misses or it would have been 5 penalty runs for South Africa.
Length ball guided away wide of point for a single by VP.
Bouncer! On middle and leg, Philander ducks under the ball letting it go through.
Length ball on top of off stump, Vernon defends it back to the bowler with a straight bat.
Short and wide again outside off, Faf punches it wide of the sweeper cover and gets a brace.
Flighted on the stumps, Faf defends it with a straight bat.
On the pads this time, du Plessis flicks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
FOUR! Short and punished by du Plessis. Shorter in length outside off, Faf gets onto his back foot and punches it through covers for a boundary.
On middle and leg, du Plessis flicks it to the fielder at short fine leg.
Flighted delivery outside leg, Faf offers no shot and lets it hit on his front pad.
Edged but does not carry. A length ball outside off, slight reverse swing. The ball takes the outside edge of Philander who was looking to defend. It goes towards slip on the bounce.
Length ball outside off, dabbed down towards gully.
Short of a length outside off, FDP pats it on the off side towards point and sets off for a quick run. The point fielder scores a direct hit at the bowler's end but Du Plessis is in very safely.
Left alone outside off once more by Faf.
Outside off and coming in slightly, du Plessis covers the line before letting it go.

The ball is being checked by the umpire for some reason. Actually the previous defense from Du Plessis pushed the ball right on the freshly painted crease during the break. The paint has come onto the ball. Waiting for it to be removed... No, actually the ball is being replaced and a similarly aged ball has been called for.
Short of a length outside off, defended back towards the bowler.
Loopy ball on the stumps, Philander blocks it.
On middle, Philander keeps it away.
Flighted on off and middle, Vernon blocks it with a straight bat.
Tossed up on middle, Philander defends it off his front foot.
Once again Embuldeniya lands it short, Vernon punches it to the fielder at cover.
Shorter in length around off, Philander defends it off his back foot.
Lasith Embuldeniya to bowl.
Gets under this short ball and pulls it through square leg for one.
WIDE! Bouncer too high. Philander ducks and the umpire gives it wide.
Little movement for Lakmal. Bowls this on a good length on off, shapes away. Faf guides it towards point to get off strike.
First run of the session. On a good length on middle, Vernon taps it with soft hands towards mid on for a single.
Goes full again on middle and leg, Philander turns his bat to the on side.
On middle this time, another front foot defense from Philander.
Bowls it fuller around off. Philander shows the full bat face and blocks it.

We are back after our Lunch. The players and the umpires are out in the middle for the afternoon session. Skipper, Faf du Plessis and Vernon Philander will resume their batting. Suranga Lakmal will bowl the first over.
... Day 3, Session 2 ...

A very good session for the hosts. Overnight batsmen, Faf du Plessis and Quinton de Kock started from where they left and both the batsmen got to their respective fifties. Quinton de Kock though didn't last longer after his half-century as he was caught straight in front of the stumps by Lasith Embuldeniya. The debutant broke the 96-run stand. Vernon Philander then joined his skipper in the middle and they have stitched an unbeaten 36-run stand.  The two have played the left-arm spinner carefully and have not taken any risk. South Africa now have a lead of 271 and it will be interesting to see their approach in the second session, whether they attack or play the calm game. Sri Lanka, meanwhile will need to get wickets as quickly as possible and restrict the South Africans to have any chance to win this game. A crucial session of this game awaits us, join us in a while for it.

Yes, it will be! Really flighted on middle, Vernon pushes it with soft hands towards mid on and sets off for a quick single. Has to hurry in the end but the fielder misses his shy at the stumps. 6 runs off the over. THAT WILL BE LUNCH ON DAY 3!
Pushed to long on for a single. 5 singles off 5 balls so far, will it be 6?
A slow off-spinner this time on the pads, VP waits for the ball and nudges it towards fine leg for a run.
Worked away by Faf to deep mid-wicket and he gets off strike.
Slower ball on middle, turned away wide of mid on for a single by Philander.
Short and wide outside off, hit away with a horizontal bat towards deep cover for a single by du Plessis.
Oshada Fernando to roll his arm over. Most probably be the last over before the Lunch break.
Another single to the right of mid off by Faf. He keeps strike for the next over.

Short of a length on the leg stump line and that rears up suddenly. Philander was prodding ahead to play that towards the leg side but then has to adjust. The ball lobs off the inside half of the bat into the vacant leg side region. Single taken.

FOUR! Edged and goes through the gap between slip and gully. A cutter outside off, no pace on that one but the ball goes off the outside edge of Philander as he looked to defend. It runs away to the third man boundary.
Hurled wide of off stump by Vishwa, Philander does not get interested.
Left alone outside off by Vernon.
Length ball outside off, defended back towards the bowler.
FOUR! Shot! What a way to end the over. Short of a length outside off, cut away beautifully in the gap by du Plessis. Doing it all too easily here.
A short ball almost bowled halfway down the track. The ball takes a lot of bounce and hits Faf on the ribs as he was trying to leave it.
Punched off the back foot towards cover by the batsman.
Shorter length this time, du Plessis stands back in his crease and looks to defend. Gets a thick inside edge onto the pads but the ball falls down safely on the pitch.
On the pads once more, Faf looks to tuck the ball away but fails to put bat on it.
Bowled outside leg, left alone by the batsman.
Slower one on the top of middle, patted on the side of the pitch by Philander and he looks for a quick single but is wisely sent back by his skipper. Would have been suicidal.
Vernon decides to leave the ball outside the off stump once more.
Way, way outside off from the left-arm seamer, left alone by Philander.

Would have been interesting had he hit! A length ball outside off, tapped towards point by du Plessis for a quick single. Philander was late on the run but luckily for him, the fielder misses his shy at the striker's end.
FOUR! That's two on the trot! A length ball outside off and the cover drive follows. This time the deep cover fielder is beaten to the right.
FOUR! Jammed away! A really full and wide ball outside off from Fernando to start the over. Du Plessis does really well to reach that ball and smash it away through backward point for a boundary.
Vishwa Fernando is back on.
On the pads, this time the South African skipper tucks it to square leg and gets a single.
The batsman has offered no stroke to an incoming delivery which is pitched outside leg.
Once again a flighted delivery outside leg, du Plessis feels it on his pad.
Pitching outside leg, Faf offers no stroke and lets it hit him on his pad.
Flighted on middle,Vernon flicks it to the on side and gets a single.
Tossed up on off, Philander defends it with a straight bat.
Length ball on middle, turned away towards mid-wicket for a run. 200 comes up for the hosts! The lead is now 244.
Pushed off the back foot towards the left of mid off. Single taken.
Length ball outside off, keeping slightly low. The South Africa skipper adjusts well and keeps it out.
Length ball just outside off, defended from the crease with a straight bat.
Really full ball, almost yorking Faf. The batsman manages to get his bat down and drive it back towards the bowler with no timing though.
A length ball sprayed way down the leg side, Faf du Plessis just lets the ball go.
Tossed up delivery on the pads, Philander looks to defend but gets hit on the pad. There is a stifled appeal but the umpire turns it down.
Another one pitching outside leg, Vernon stretches out his front foot and lets it hit there.
Flighted on the pads, Philander offers no stroke and lets it hit on his front pad.

Soft hands to the rescue. Flighted delivery on odd and middle, the ball spins away after pitching. Du Plessis looks to defend it but finds the outside edge. He played it with soft hands and that's why it falls short of the slip fielder.
No run.
On the pads, Faf flicks it away to the fielder at short fine leg.
Short of a length outside off, VP rides the bounce and defends the ball onto the ground.
Bouncer! On middle and Philander ducks under it to let the ball go.
A short of a length ball this time outside off, defended from the crease.
Fuller length ball outside off, dead-batted by Vernon coming slightly ahead.
Fuller length ball outside off, driven wide of mid off for a run by the skipper.
Outside off on a good length, defended back to the bowler by Faf.
Flighted on the stumps, Philander gets his front foot out and blocks it.
On the pads, the Proteas skipper tucks it towards the on side for a single.

No ball. Quicker on middle, Faf defends it off his front foot. It is a no ball as Embuldeniya took the bails off. But the replays show it is a very cruel decision as he was nowhere close to the stumps.
Once again lands it outside off, again Du Plessis offers no shot and lets it hit on his pad.
Loopy delivery pitching outside leg, Faf lets it hit on his front pad.
On middle and leg, Vernon tucks it away to mid-wicket and takes a single.
Flighted on off, Philander blocks it off his front foot.
On the pads, flicked away through square leg for one.
Outside off, left alone.
Philander lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Bouncer! Vernon ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.
Fifty for the skipper! Wide outside off, Faf cuts it through point to get his 18th Test fifty. An important knock in the circumstances.
Length outside off, left alone!
Vernon Philander is the new man in.

OUT! Yes it is a wasted review. It looked plumb and it is plumb. Off spinner pitching outside off on the rough. It keeps low after pitching. De Kock looks to flick it to the on side but gets beaten and hit on the pads. The debutant is up in celebration and the umpire also raises his finger. De Kock goes for the referral and the Hawk Eye shows all red as it was going to crash into the middle pole. South Africa lose their review and the partnership of 96 is broken. P.s - its the third wicket for the debutant in this innings.
Flighted on middle and leg, du Plessis pushes it to the fielder at mid on and takes a single.
Review time... Quinton de Kock has been adjudged LBW here. Looked like he is plumb in front and de Kock has just gone upstairs in sheer hope. Might be a wasted review!
Flighted on off, du Plessis pushes it to cover.
Slow and spinning in to the batsman. It is pitched on middle and leg, Faf initially looks to play but then he does not and the ball hits him on his thigh pad.
Tossed up on middle, Faf defends it with a straight bat.
Flighted on off, de Kock flicks it away towards square leg for a single.
Outside off, Faf offers no shot.
Length delivery on off, du Plessis looks to defend it but gets an outside edge. He plays it with soft hands so it goes to the fielder at gully on a bounce who dives to his right.
Tempting the South African skipper to drive by bowling it outside off. Du Plessis though is not tempted and leaves it.
Full on middle and off, Faf hits it to the fielder at mid on.
Back of a length outside off, du Plessis hits it towards mid off with a slant bat.
On middle and leg, de Kock flicks it away towards mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Change of ends for Kasun Rajitha.
Fuller and flighted on middle, driven to long on for a single. Quinton keeps strike.
Worked away off the pads to square leg for a run.
Bowled way down the leg side, Faf lets the ball go.
Lovely loop on that ball. Faf du Plessis looks to work that one away on the leg side but closes his bat face too quickly. The ball goes off the leading edge towards the off side.
Fuller and quicker outside off, driven all along the ground by de Kock through cover-point for a single.
Flatter one outside off, defended with soft hands off the back foot by the southpaw.
Lasith Embuldeniya is now into the attack, the first time this morning.

Low full toss on middle, de Kock tucks it away towards mid-wicket. Quinton goes for a quick single, the fielder has a shy at the bowler's end. He misses and the fielder backing up behind misfields and they take 2 more runs. Quinton with those 3 runs gets to his 16th Test fifty. Second of the match.
Good looking shot! Length delivery outside off, du Plessis punches it towards sweeper cover and gets to the other end.
Bouncer! On the leg stump line, Faf ducks underneath it.
On the pads, de Kock tucks it away towards fine leg for a single.
Full length delivery around off, the South African wicket keeper drives it to the fielder at cover.
Kusal Mendis has gone off the field and Lakshan Sandakan is replacing him.
On middle and leg, de Kock flicks it away to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Good length delivery around off, du Plessis punches it to the fielder on the off side.
Slightly fuller this time by Kasun,Faf pushes it to the fielder at mid on.
Back of a length delivery on off, du Plessis hits it to the fielder at mid off.

Chance, actually no it's a no ball! Full length delivery on off, the ball slightly goes away from the batsman after pitching. Du Plessis looks to drive it but gets an outside edge. The ball falls short of the diving second slip fielder. Kusal Mendis there tries to catch it but it stings on his little finger and he is in a lot of pain. Such a great effort but it wouldn't have counted as Rajitha had overstepped his line. Also the batsmen meanwhile take a couple.

Kusal Mendis is in a lot of pain here hurting his finger while going for a catch. That will require some medical attention. Let's hope it is nothing serious... Meanwhile, Drinks has also been called for. The first hour of the game has been all South Africa. Faf du Plessis and Quinton de Kock are slowly but surely batting the Lankans out of the game.
Shorter in length this time by Rajitha, Quinton pulls it away for a single.

FOUR! Lovely shot. Full and straight on off, de Kock just gets on his front foot and drives it with ease straight through mid off. Lasith Embuldeniya gives it a chase but the ball wins the race and goes to the fence.
Good length delivery on middle, de Kock defends it off his back foot.
Good length delivery on off, du Plessis keeps it out with a solid back foot defense to see off the over.
Back of a length delivery around off, Faf hits it to the fielder at cover.
Length delivery outside off, no swing on this one. Faf leaves it alone.
Du Plessis is not ready and sends Lakmal back to reload his run up.
Lakmal bowls this at 125 case, on a length. De Kock pushes it towards mid on and takes a quick single.
Full and straight around off, de Kock drives it straight to the mid off fielder.
On middle and leg by Lakmal, du Plessis flicks it away to mid-wicket for a single.
Once again on middle and leg, Faf nudges it to square leg and gets a run.
On middle and leg, this time Quinton tucks it to the on side and gets only a single.
Good shot! On the pads by Rajitha, de Kock handsomely flicks it away towards mid-wicket but there's a fielder in the deep so he only gets a brace.
Good length delivery outside off, de Kock does not get in its way and lets it go.
Full again, this time on middle and leg, Faf pushes it wide of mid on and takes a single.
FOUR! Easy for du Plessis. Rajitha bowls it full and straight around leg, Faf just flicks it away through the vacant fine leg region for a boundary. Poor start by Kasun.
Kasun Rajitha is now into the attack.
Fuller length deliver on middle and off, it comes back in after pitching. De Kock flicks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Full and straight around off, Quinton hits it straight but does not time it well.  The ball does not go to the fence but he gets a couple.
Back of a length delivery on the stumps, this time Quinton is able to defend it.

Ouch! Good length delivery around off, the ball comes in with the angle. De Kock looks to defend it but the ball hits him on his gloves and then goes on and hits him on the unmentionable region. De Kock is in pain and understandably so.
Good length delivery on off, du Plessis pushes it away towards cover for a single.
Length delivery outside off, the Proteas skipper leaves it alone.
On the pads, du Plessis tucks it towards square leg and gets a run. He will keep the strike for the start of the next over.
Flighted on the stumps, Faf taps it back to the bowler.
Tossed up around off, de Kock pushes it away towards cover and takes a single.
On the pads, Faf flicks it to the on side and rotates the strike. The lead now is 200 for South Africa.
Quicker around off, du Plessis pushes it to the fielder at cover.
Loopy delivery outside off, de Kock nudges it towards deep cover and takes a single.
Left alone outside off by Faf to end the over. 8 runs off this one, courtesy the two boundaries.
Kept out towards the cover region.
Outside off, defended with soft hands towards point.
FOUR! This is a good ball but such is the class of Faf du Plessis. The Proteas skipper just pushes this wide of mid off and the ball is so well-timed that the fielder has no chance.
On the money this time from Lakmal, du Plessis watchfully defends it towards the mid-wicket region.

FOUR! First runs off Lakmal this morning! A fuller one outside off, beautifully driven through cover for a boundary by Faf. The first time Suranga has bowled a half-volley this morning and he has gotten punished.

FOUR! This one goes through! A short ball outside off, cut away by de Kock wide of point. The fielder dives but cannot stop the ball. It goes to the rope. This also brings up the 50-run stand between these two.
Good fielding! A fuller and flighted ball outside off, driven towards the right of cover. The fielder does well to move, dive and stop the ball. Prevents the single.
A flatter arm ball outside off, left alone by Quinton.
Shorter and quicker outside off, punched towards the cover fielder once more.
Flighted outside off, driven towards cover on the front foot.
Yes, no! But all is well in the end. A flatter one at the pads, tucked towards square leg by de Kock and the batsmen look for a run but then decide against it.
Dhananjaya de Silva to bowl now.
On a length outside off, patted towards point and du Plessis looks for a quick run but is sent back by his partner. Ends the over, third maiden on the trot for Suranga Lakmal.
On a length outside off, left alone by the right-hander.
Length ball on top of off stump, turned towards square leg.
Way outside off this time and it does not interest the batsman who just lets it go.
Left alone outside off this time.
Short of a length outside off, Faf du Plessis stands tall and defends it back to the bowler.
Very full on the middle and leg stump line, flicked away through mid-wicket by the southpaw for a couple. An expensive over, 11 off it in the end.
FOUR! Two in two! This is even better. A fuller length ball on middle and de Kock just pushes it casually back past mid on and all the way to the rope.
FOUR! Amazing shot! Some width outside off on a length and Quinton de Kock just leans into the drive and times it superbly away wide of deep cover for a boundary.
Fuller length now, driven straight back to the mid off fielder.
Length ball on top of off stump, pushed back towards the bowler with a straight bat.
Outside off on a length, good shot from Faf du Plessis towards deep cover-point for just a run though.
Kept out watchfully towards cover by de Kock to end the over. 2nd maiden on the trot for Lakmal.

Ouch! That must have stung! A length ball coming in with the angle and Quinton de Kock fails to put bat on ball. It goes on and hits him in the box. Winces in a bit of pain but looks okay to continue.
Length ball outside off, driven on the front foot to the mid off fielder by the southpaw.
Pushed towards mid on off the front foot.
Fuller length ball just outside off, this time South Africa's keeper-batsman defends it watchfully towards the leg side.
Good length ball outside off, holding the line and going away from the lefty. Quinton shoulders arms to it.
A single to deep cover-point to end the over. 5 off it in the end and QDK keeps strike for the next one.
Outside off on a length, de Kock mistimes his cover drive back towards the bowler from the inside half of the bat.
On the middle stump line now, pushed towards mid-wicket.
Edged and four! Again wide outside off and this time, de Kock leans into the drive. The ball catches the edge and goes to the right of gully. No third man means a boundary results.
Play and a miss! A length ball wide outside off and coming in after landing, de Kock goes for the slash without foot movement. The ball just whizzes past the outside edge.
Length ball outside off, a solid front foot defense back to the bowler from Quinton.
Vishwa Fernando to bowl from the other end.
The skipper lets the ball go outside his off stump once more to end the over. Maiden to start off Day 3.
Slightly fuller outside off, left alone.
Length ball outside off, defended onto the ground on the off side.

Loud appeal but the umpire is unmoved! A lovely ball from Lakmal just outside off, Faf looks to make a leave but the ball jags in a bit and goes off the top of his pad and to the keeper. He was hit outside the line of the off pole and hence the appeal is turned down by the umpire.
By the way, the Sun is out and it is shining nice and bright right now...
Goes fuller this time, Faf defends with soft hands towards the off side.
Starts off with a ball on good length outside off, left alone by Du Plessis.

The players and the officials make their way to the middle. Faf du Plessis and Quinton de Kock, the overnight batsmen. The skipper will be on strike for the first ball today. It will be bowled by Suranga Lakmal. Exciting stuff ahead, let's play!!!

Hello and welcome to Day 3 of the the First Test. This game is really evenly poised as it stands. The home team might just have their noses very, very slightly ahead in the game as it stands but do not rule the visitors out as yet. The surface still has help for the pacers if they bowl in the right areas. With the conditions being overcast in the morning, a few early wickets for Sri Lanka will see them be right back in the reckoning. Faf du Plessis and Quinton de Kock holds the key for the Proteas in this fascinating game and the hosts will look to score a total that will really be out of reach for the away team in the fourth innings. Anything can happen, let's just hope that the match continues in the same way it has gone so far, with a terrific battle between bat and ball. The first ball of the day coming up soon!
... Day 3, Session 1 ...

Right then, South Africa have a healthy lead of 170 with 6 wickets in hand. There is still plenty of time left in this Test and they would like to bat for as long as possible. As of now, let's concentrate on Day 3. That will begin on Friday at 1000 local (0800 GMT). Do join us. Till then, take care!
Debutant, Lasith Embuldeniya had an awesome day out. He showed some fight with the bat and picked up two important wickets with the ball. Rajitha and Fernando ended the day with a wicket each.

The Proteas showed some patience at the start of their 2nd innings but then lost wickets in the middle to give the visitors a sniff. Skipper, du Plessis and de Kock are going along well and would hope they swell the lead to as much as possible.

Another eventful day comes to an end. 13 wickets falling and some gritty knocks played. Sri Lanka have done well to pick up four wickets but South Africa still hold the upper hand. The tourists didn't have the best of starts. They lost early wickets and succumbed to pressure. Courtesy Perera's 50 and some resolute defending by Embuldeniya, the Islanders although managed to cut the hosts' lead to 44.
FOUR! Tossed up delivery outside off, de Kock brilliantly drives it through covers and the ball races away to the fence. Stumps on Day 2. South Africa lead by 170 runs.
On the pads this time, du Plessis has no problem nudging it towards mid-wicket and rotating the strike. Sri Lanka are offering easy singles to these two.
Loopy delivery on the stumps, Faf keeps it out with a classical front foot defense.
Tossed up delivery around off, de Kock pushes it towards point and gets to the other end.
On middle and leg, Faf tucks it away to mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Shorter delivery outside off, du Plessis blocks it away.
On the pads, Du Plessis tucks it to the on side and keeps the strike.
Length delivery on the stumps, the South African skipper defends it off his front foot.
Good length delivery outside off, Faf leaves it alone.
Good length delivery outside off, du Plessis defends it.
Good length delivery around off, Quinton looks to defend it but it goes towards  gully from the outer half of the bat and they take a single.
Full and straight on off, de Kock defends it off his front foot.
Flighted on middle, the skipper blocks it off his front foot.
FOUR! Short and wide by Embuldeniya, du Plessis cuts it beautifully wide of the point fielder for a boundary.
Shorter delivery around off, Faf punches it to the fielder at mid off.
Flighted outside off, Faf hits it to the fielder at point.
Straighter delivery on middle, du Plessis defends it.
Shorter in length around middle and leg, de Kock flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Good length delivery on off, du Plessis waits for it and plays it late. He guides it to the fielder at gully.
Good length delivery outside off, du Plessis lets the keeper get a feel of the ball.
Full and straight on the fifth stump line, Faf does not disturb it.
Length delivery outside off, du Plessis points his bat skywards and leaves it alone.
On the fourth stump line, Faf leaves it alone.
On middle and leg, de Kock flicks it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
Surangal Lakmal is in for another spell.

In the air but safe. Flighted delivery on middle and off, de Kock looks to play it against the spin towards covers. It comes off the inside half of the bat and flies away wide of the mid-wicket fielder for a single.
Flighted on off, Faf nudges it to long off and takes a single.
Loopy delivery around off, du Plessis drives it to the fielder at cover.
Shorter in length, de Kock punches it to covers and takes a single.
Flighted on middle and off, Quinton pushes it to the fielder at mid on.
Tossed up delivery on off and middle, de Kock defends it with a straight bat.
Down the leg side, de Kock flicks but it goes off his thigh pad to the on side for one. Leg byes given by the umpire.
On the hips, tucked away to deep square leg to get to the other end.
A bit too far outside off, Faf doesn't bother playing at it.
Length ball outside off, punched to the off side by the skipper.
Faf chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump. No ball given by the umpire.
Outside off, cut behind point for a single.
Fuller ball on middle, de Kock on-drives it through mid on and collects a brace.
FOUR! Tossed up delivery on off, du Plessis uses his feet brilliantly. He comes down the track and lofts it over mid off for a boundary.
On the pads, du Plessis flicks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Shorter in length, Faf hits it to the fielder at cover.
Dangerous! Faf comes down the track, Embuldeniya sees it and bowls it a bit wide outside off. Du Plessis reaches it and gets his bat to it.
Flighted outside off, du Plessis punches it to the fielder at cover.
Shorter in length on middle, de Kock tucks it to fine leg and gets a single.
PEACH! Nips back in! Rajitha is in a nice rhythm! Gets this to come back into Faf who gets a glove to it onto his thigh pad.
Fullish, a bit of away movement. Faf blocks it out well.
Down the leg side, helped away to fine leg for one more.
Strays down leg, Faf tucks it away around the corner for one.
Another good length ball outside off, left alone by Faf.
Length ball outside off, Faf doesn't bother playing at it. That kept low too.
Quinton de Kock is the new man in.

OUT! Embuldeniya strikes after drinks. Flighted delivery on middle and off, Elgar comes down the track and drives it straight. He hits it uppishly and Lasith Embuldeniya shows good reflexes and takes a good catch on his left. Elgar was looking good out in the middle but has to walk back. What a day Embuldeniya is having. First with the bat and now 2 wickets already. Can Sri Lanka pick another one before Stumps?
On the pads, du Plessis flicks it away to the on side for a single.
Flatter on middle, Faf comes down the track and blocks it.
Lands it on middle and leg, du Plessis blocks it away.
Flighted on middle, Faf comes down the track and defends it.
Bowls it short and outside off, du Plessis punches it to the fielder at cover.
Rajitha bowls it outside off stump, Elgar sees off the over by leaving it.
Full on middle and leg, Elgar pushes it to the fielder at mid on.
On the fourth stump line, Dean leaves it alone.
Full on middle and leg, Elgar defends it off his front foot.
Good length delivery around off, Dean looks to play it with an angled bat but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Length delivery outside off, Elgar leaves it alone.
Kasun Rajitha back into the attack.
DRINKS!
Gets behind this ball and blocks it out solidly.
FOUR! Fraction shot on off, Faf punches this through covers and the ball races away to the boundary. Commanding shot.
Elgar has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
That ball has taken the inside edge onto the pads.
Risky run but the fielder fails to hit the target. Faf charges down and hits it towards mid off. The fielder charges to it and has a shy at the non-striker's end but doesn't hit the target.
On leg, flicked away through mid-wicket for an easy run.
Ripper! Good length delivery on off and middle, the ball jags back in after pitching. Du Plessis gets beaten, it dissects him in half and goes between the bat and pads to the keeper.
FOUR! Short and punished. Full outside off, the ball keeps a bit low and du Plessis cuts it through backward point for a boundary.
On middle and leg, du Plessis tucks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Length delivery on off, du Plessis punches it to the fielder at cover.
Good length delivery on off and middle, Faf blocks it away.
Good length delivery outside off. Fernando gets a little bit of extra bounce there. Du Plessis looks to cut but misses. There is a stifled appeal by Vishwa but the umpire is not interested.
Similar ball, Elgar turns his bat to the on side.
On middle and leg, flicked to mid-wicket.
Gets to the pitch of the ball and hits this towards mid on for a single.
Faf stays inside and keeps this out.
Faf has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tossed up around off, driven to covers.

DROPPED! FOUR! Straight to Mendis at first slip but it goes through him. What a chance! That would have been three quick wickets for the tourists. Length ball on off, Elgar hangs his bat out and gets an outside edge and it goes through Mendis at slip. He fails to get his hands together in time and the ball goes between his legs and rolls to the third man fence. This was one of the simpler ones for Kusal.
Full and around off, pushed to covers.
Goes short again, Elgar ducks under this.
Wide!  Unusual bounce. Too high to worry the batsman! Wide signalled by the umpire.
Length ball on off, punched off the back foot to the cover-point region.
Outside off, Elgar leaves it alone.
Full on off, driven to covers. Dot ball.
Fuller ball on middle, played towards mid on.
Beauty! Off spinner around off. Faf goes ahead to play at it but gets beaten for the turn.
Outside off, punched off the back foot.
Faf gets behind this one and keeps it out.
Skipper, Faf du Plessis walks out to bat.

OUT! Nothing, three reds and he is plumb! Straighter one on middle. Bavuma gets low to sweep but misses it completely. He gets hit on his pads and the players put in an appeal. The umpire raises his finger and Sri Lanka are up in celebration. Bavuma consults his partner and takes it up. Replays show us there was no glove and the ball would have gone to hit the stumps. Was unfortunate to get out in the first innings, but he has himself to blame here. South Africa lead by 121 runs.
Review time! Bavuma is given out lbw but takes it up. Looks out. Has it brushed the gloves though?
Pushed to the cover region by Bavuma.
On middle and leg, tucked away to the on side.
Over the off pole, punched through cover-point for one.
Gets this closer to the stumps but Bavuma covers his stumps and lets this one through.
Way wide outside off, Bavuma doesn't flirt with it.
Outside off, left alone.
Inside edge but well short of Dickwella. Length ball over the stumps, Bavuma plays away from his body and gets a faint inside edge which falls short of the keeper.
Strays down leg, Bavuma tucks it around the corner for a single.
On off, punches it to the off side.
TB has driven it through mid off.
In line of the stumps, stonewalled by Temba.
On middle, Bavuma is solid in his defense.
Flighted ball on middle, Bavuma looks to sweep but gets a bottom edge back to the bowler.
Elgar has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! More like a defensive shot but it travels to the fence. Overpitched on middle and leg, Elgar on-drives it through mid on and gets himself another boundary.
Closer to the off pole, Bavuma gets an outside edge which runs to the third man region. He wants the second but Elgar sends him back rightly.
Outside off, no problem for Bavuma in leaving it alone.
Length ball around off, played towards covers.
The new man in is Temba Bavuma.

OUT! Soft dismissal. Previously, he got the ball past gully many times. He tries that again but finds the man stationed for that shot. Length ball outside off, Amla stands tall and tries to cut it past the gully region. Cannot keep the ball down, perhaps Fernando got some extra bounce to this. Thirimanne there takes the catch and Amla has to walk back. His poor form in Durban and in Test cricket off late continues.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Comes out again and turns this through mid-wicket for one.
Well bowled! Amla steps down but decides to defend it.
Loopy ball on middle, well blocked by Amla.
Elgar rocks back and tucks it through square leg to get off strike.
Off spinner on middle, played back to the bowler.
Amla chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Stands inside the crease and taps this in front of him.
Misses out! This was outside off again. Amla looks to get it past gully again but fails to connect.
Outside off, cut to point.
FOUR! Even better! Outside off, all Amla had to do was get it past gully and the pace would do the rest. He pierces the gap past gully and gets a boundary.

FOUR! Back of a length ball around off, Amla gets on his toes and just punches it off his back foot. The ball goes through cover-point. The fielder in the deep dives but cannot stop it from crossing the fence.
Loopy delivery on middle and leg, Elgar pushes it to the fielder at mid on.
On middle and leg, Dean tucks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Loopy delivery on middle, Amla comes down the track and pushes it to long on for a single.
Tossed up on middle and off, Amla defends it off his front foot.
On the pads, this time Elgar is able to tuck it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted on middle, Elgar looks to flick it but the fielder at short leg does well and stops the ball.
Length outside off, Amla let's it be.
Shows the full face of the bat and blocks this solidly.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Outside off again, another easier leave for Amla.
Length ball outside off, good leave from Amla.
Down leg, Elgar works it off his pads to give his partner the strike.
Vishwa Fernando is back into the attack.
Amla gets behind this ball and keeps it out.
Off breaker on middle, Amla flicks it away to the on side.
Covers his stumps and bunts this one out.
Another loopy ball around off, Amla guides it towards backward point.
Opens the bat face and helps this towards short third man.
Good start. Tossed it outside off, draws Amla forward who gets an outside edge which rolls towards third man. They come back for the second. The lead has now crossed 100.
Lasith Embuldeniya to roll his arms over.
Shorter in length outside off, Elgar sways away from it.
FOUR! Short, wide and punished. Back of a length delivery outside off, Elgar's eyes lit up looking at that and he wonderfully cuts it through point for a boundary.
On middle and leg, Elgar flicks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
On the pads, Amla tucks it towards fine leg and gets to the other end.

That is so close. Full length delivery, the ball initially comes in and then straightens after pitching. Amla looks to push it but misses. The ball goes past his outside edge and misses it but just a whisker. There is a half-hearted appeal and the umpire turns it down.
Full outside off, Amla leaves it alone.
Drinks break. South Africa are well on top of this game. They are 50/1 after the end of 13 overs. They have lost Aiden Markram but Dean Elgar is still out there joined by Hashim Amla.
Full on off, Elgar looks to defend it but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
On the pads, Hashim nudges it to the fielder at deep square leg for a single. 50 comes up for South Africa.
Full on middle, it swings in a bit. Amla does well to block it.
Good length delivery on off stump, Amla defends it to the fielder at point.
Good length delivery outside off, Amla shoulders arms to that one.
Good length delivery on the stumps, Hashim defends it with a straight bat.
Length delivery around off, Amla pushes it to point and keeps the strike.
Fuller in length outside off, Elgar drives it through covers. He does not time it well but manages to get three runs.
Full outside off stump, Dean shoulders arms to it.
On middle and leg, Hashim tucks it away to the on side and gets to the other end.
Length delivery on the leg side, Amla looks to flick it away but misses.

Shot! Full outside off, Elgar drives it through covers. He does not time it well so it does not have the legs to reach the fence. Kusal Perera runs behind it and puts in a dive way before the ropes. Elgar has enough time to take three runs.
Good length delivery on middle and off, Amla blocks it confidently.
Shorter in length, Elgar pulls it away to square leg for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Dean leaves it alone.

FOUR! Not the most convincing boundary. Full and once again a hint of away swing for Lakmal. Elgar looks to defend it with soft hands but gets an outside edge. The ball goes away through gully for a boundary.
Great ball! Length delivery outside off, Elgar looks to drive it through cover but the ball moves away after pitching and misses the outside edge by just a whisker.
Length delivery outside off, Elgar leaves it alone.
Hashim Amla walks out at number 3.

OUT! Aiden Markram falls! First wicket for the visitors. Rajitha pulls his length back on this occasion and bowls it on the off stump. The ball swings away after pitching. Markram looks to punch it through covers but he ends up edging it to the fielder at second slip. Kusal Mendis there takes a very good catch at a comfortable height. Rajitha is rewarded for his good spell of bowling.
Full on middle and leg, Markram pushes it to the fielder at mid on.
Full around off, Aiden defends it.

FOUR! Pure class. Full on off, Markram drives it straight from the middle of the bat. Rajitha gets his hand to it but the ball is timed so well that the fielder chasing it has no chance of stopping that.
Full outside off, Aiden hits it wide of the fielder at deep point and gets a couple.
Full on the fourth stump line, Markram leaves it alone.
Full again by Lakmal, Dean defends it with a straight bat to finish the over.
Fuller this time on off, Elgar taps it back to the bowler.
Length delivery on middle and leg, Dean defends it with soft hands and guides it towards point.
Full on off, the ball comes with the angle, Elgar tucks it away to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Length delivery outside off, Elgar leaves it alone.
On middle and leg, Markram flicks it away towards square leg and gets to the other end.
Back of a length delivery on middle and off, Dean defends it.
Good shot. Full around off, Markram drives it through point. Dhananjaya de Silva dives to his right and saves a certain boundary. He cannot hold the ball though so they take a single.
Fuller this time on the stumps, Aiden defends it with straight bat.
Good length delivery around off, Markram defends it with soft hands.
Length delivery outside off, this time Markram decides to leave it alone.
FOUR! Welcome to the crease Rajitha. Good length delivery outside off, Markram cuts it through point. He times it to perfection and the ball races away to the fence.
Kasun Rajitha is the first bowling change of the inning.

Appeal but that is going down leg! Gets the last one to come back in. Elgar looks to flick it but it hits his pad. The players appeal and then realize it is going down. Perhaps, must have got an inside edge to this too.
The best of the lot. Full and on off, Elgar leans ahead and misses it.
Full and wide. Elgar shoulders his arms to it.
This is much better! On a good length outside off, Elgar looks to punch it but it goes past his outside edge.
Closer to the stumps this, still away to entice Dean with a drive.
This is too wide outside off to make Elgar play.
On the leg side, Dean looks to flicks it but it comes off his thigh pad and goes towards the fine leg region. The batsmen steal a single, Leg byes signaled by the umpire.
Better from Elgar. Good length delivery on the stumps, Dean this time defends it off the middle of his bat.

FOUR! Unlucky for the bowler. Good length delivery on off, the ball moves away just a bit after pitching. Elgar looks to defend it but because of the moment it finds the outside edge and flies away wide of the second slip fielder for a boundary.
On the pads this time by Fernando. Markram flicks it towards deep square leg, the fiuelder comes running from fine leg and saves a boundary. Markram meanwhile gets three runs.
On middle and leg, Markram flicks it away towards mid-wicket. Embuldeniya dives to his right and saves runs for his side.
Length delivery outside off, Aiden does not go chasing after it and leaves it alone.
Full on off stump, Dean keeps it out with a classical front foot defense.
Outside off by Lakmal, Elgar shoulders arms to it.

Does not time it well. Back of a length delivery on off, Markram pulls it but it comes from the lower half of the bat. The ball goes towards deep mid-wicket but does not have the legs to reach the fence. The batsmen come back for the third.
This one is on the fifth stump line and Aiden need not play at those and he does not.
Hint of swing for Lakmal. It is on the fourth stump line, Markram covers his off stump and leaves it alone.
Good length delivery outside off, Markram lets it go to the keeper.
A touch short ball on off, jumping onto the batsman, Elgar is hurried up as he blocks it to the leg side.
This one is pitched up slightly but the line is too wide outside off to bother the batsman.
Good length ball outside off, going straight on, Elgar allows it through to the keeper.
Plays this one with the angle of the bowler. It's around off and Aiden pushes it with angled bat through point for one.
Goes for a big inswinger but fails to control his line. Sprays it way down the leg side and Markram tries his best to get some wood behind it.
Beauty to beat the outside edge. The natural angle of Vishwa takes a length ball away from the right-hander. Markram stays back to push inside the line but misses.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.

Fractionally short and outside off, Elgar goes on his toes and strokes it through covers for a couple. Once again Dean runs straight down the pitch. The umpire is keeping a close eye on it and it won't be too long before he takes some action.
Straighter in line, Aiden works it to the right of widish mid on fielder and steals a single. Good batting.

FOUR! This is a brilliant shot! Lakmal bowls it on a length around off, angling into the batsman, Markram offers a straight bat to it and caresses it down the ground for a boundary. The lead crosses 50.
Just short! A length ball angling into the batsman from around off, Aiden flicks it across the line off his pads, it's aerial but doesn't carry to the short mid-wicket fielder.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Markram punches it from the back foot. It goes on one bounce to the cover fielder.
End of an innocuous over, a maiden. Vishwa keeps on pitching in the channel outside off. Elgar has nothing to do with it.
The count goes to 5. Outside off, it's allowed through to the keeper.
Make it four leaves in a row to pretty much harmless deliveries wide outside off.
Continues to be wayward. Good length delivery wide outside off, left alone with ease.
Wayward once more. Fernando is getting some good shape but his line is too wide outside off. Dean is not chasing those.
A loosener first up from Vishwa as well. Bowls it gently wide outside off, Elgar makes an easy leave.
Vishwa Fernando will share the new ball from the other end.

A neat back foot punch again from Markram. It pierces the gap at covers for another couple of runs. Aleem Dar walks up to both the batsmen and warns them to not run on the danger area. Not an official warning.
Angles in a good length ball on off, straightening a bit, Markram gets behind the line and blocks it down safely.
A shade short in length outside off, Aiden goes on the back foot and punches it through the gap at covers. Takes a couple of runs to get off the mark.
In the channel outside off, Markram watches the line closely and finds it to be too far to play at. Shoulders arms.
Good line for the right-hander. It's on a length just outside off, Markram defends it off his back foot.
Begins with a good length delivery down the leg side, a gentle loosener, Elgar helps it to fine leg and opens his account.
